sent_to_model:
Someone in my building taped a note in the lobby calling me a creep for flying my drone off the roof deck. I need a letter to all the residents that I can slip under doors, everyone gets one. It needs to be formal and calm because honestly I'm upset and I don't trust myself to write it without it getting snippy. I want to explain what I was actually doing, say sorry that it worried people, and offer to show the footage. Please don't name or hint at who I think wrote the note.

- building is Larkspur Lofts on N Williams, 24 units, I'm in 5A, been here 3 years
- flew Sat Oct 31 around 4pm, about 11 min total, new drone (Halvard Mini 4) testing it before a vineyard wedding in Dundee
- camera pointed west at the river and the Fremont Bridge the whole time, never at windows
- HOA rules say nothing about drones. Board meeting is Nov 19, 7pm, community room
- note said "Whoever is spying with a drone from the roof - we know it's you in 5A. Creep." with my unit number
- a neighbor I like (Doreen, 2C) told me her grandkids were freaked out seeing it hover
- I get why it looked bad, a buzzing thing over the courtyard is weird if you don't know
- calling me a creep in the lobby with my unit number on it was not ok, felt like being outed
- I think it's 3B (old parking spot fight) but NOT putting that in
- offer to show the full unedited clip to anyone, knock on 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example
- not flying from the roof again until the board decides on a rule, I'll ask them to add it to the Nov 19 agenda
- ask that next time people come talk to me directly instead of notes

(About me: wedding photographer, 32, Portland, Oregon. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Explains the drone test and where the camera was pointed.
Apologises for worrying residents and offers anyone the full unedited clip, with contact via 5A or jess.okafor@mailbox.example.
States the pause on roof flights pending a board rule and requests direct conversation about future concerns.
Commits to asking the board to add drone rules to the November 19 meeting agenda.
must_not_reveal: The identity of the suspected note writer, including unit 3B or hints about the earlier parking dispute.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
